result.question: How does Nvidia describe competition for its data center products?
result.answer: Nvidia describes its target markets as remaining competitive, with competition that may intensify due to expanding and changing product and service offerings, evolving industry standards, shifting customer and market needs, new entrants, and consolidations [0001045810-26-000052:part-ii--item-1a-p001]. The company states that other companies compete with it on a wide range of parameters including price, total cost of ownership, and performance, which has resulted and may in the future result in lower-than-expected selling prices or demand for its products [0001045810-26-000052:part-ii--item-1a-p001]. Nvidia notes that some competitors operate their own fabrication facilities and have longer operating histories, larger customer bases, more comprehensive IP portfolios and patent protections, more design wins, and greater financial, sales, marketing and distribution resources [0001045810-26-000052:part-ii--item-1a-p001]. These competitors may be able to acquire market share or prevent Nvidia from doing so, more effectively identify and capitalize upon opportunities in new markets and end-user trends, more quickly transition their products, and impinge on Nvidia's ability to procure sufficient foundry capacity and scarce input materials during a supply-constrained environment [0001045810-26-000052:part-ii--item-1a-p001]. Specifically regarding data center products, Nvidia states that some of its customers are developing their own ASICs and other products, including designs optimized for certain workloads that may not require all of the features and functionality its data center systems provide [0001045810-26-000052:part-ii--item-1a-p001]. Others may offer cloud-based services that compete with Nvidia's AI cloud service offerings, and Nvidia may not be able to establish market share sufficient to achieve the scale necessary to meet its business objectives [0001045810-26-000052:part-ii--item-1a-p001]. If Nvidia is unable to successfully compete in this environment, demand for its products, services, and technologies could decrease, which may negatively impact its business [0001045810-26-000052:part-ii--item-1a-p001].
